building: Hungkuo Delin University of Technology Hospitality and Culinary Arts Teaching Building (Han-Jian Hall)
era: 2016 completed building exterior, constrained by 2017-09-17 photograph; later landscape and undated PV excluded
nominal_scale: 1:400; mixed published design values and explicitly estimated dimensions, not survey
local_axes: +X approximately north, +Y approximately west, +Z up; east/front is -Y. Right-handed output, not surveyed bearing.
published_height_datum: Unresolved; not forced to equal the model's relative highest point
frame_height_sensitivity_note: Unverified sensitivity assumption only, not a measured error bound
source_values: PC grid 0-9 adds to 81.90 m, not outside wall length
PC local C-G adds to 20.30 m, not total building depth
1F 4.8 m / upper floors 4.4 m are design-analysis rhythm, not confirmed as-built levels
scope_exclusions: Invented west or hidden south windows
plan_parameter_convention: Plan values below use drawing coordinates U south-to-north and V west-to-east. Export maps U to X and V to -Y to preserve right-handed north/west/up.
geometry_construction: Authored CSG primitive coordinates canonicalized to 1e-6 mm before union; consolidated construction provenance with as_original().simplify(1e-7 mm) before the first STL export. Exported original STL is never repaired or resampled.
material_assignment: Bounding regions assign materials only when every vertex of the original triangle is inside; never centroid-only across a large face
display_wall_palette: Wall, floor, column, core and roof share the same neutral wall color to avoid fabricated diagonal color boundaries where original CSG triangles span source material regions; distinct frame shade, rails, glazing, screen and base remain
